name: Wikipedia Editing
what_you_do: Anyone can edit Wikipedia, even without an account. Start with small fixes and use the tutorials.
who_can_apply: Open to almost anyone, even without logging in. The page links to guidance for younger editors but states no minimum age.
how_to_apply: Start editing, or make a free account (not required). Try The Wikipedia Adventure tutorial.
notes: Protect your personal info; do not share your school or address.
